review.rationale: The claim falsely asserts a single, dominant pattern across the entire packet of material, ignoring the diverse and specific contexts of the debates presented in the excerpts. The excerpts represent distinct debates with different agendas and concerns, demonstrating a lack of a single dominant pattern.

retrieved_rules.detection_check: Locate the assertion and test its evidence-to-claim warrant.
retrieved_rules.evidence_requirement: Identify relevant exact passages or an explicit whole-packet missing warrant.
retrieved_rules.countercondition: A defensible alternative interpretation alone is not a flaw.

retrieved_rules.applicability: Attribution, scope, causal or aggregate claims
retrieved_rules.detection_check: Check speaker, scope, negation, uncertainty and consequential countercases.
retrieved_rules.evidence_requirement: Compare each relevant account under its actual stated conditions.
retrieved_rules.countercondition: Do not infer missing context or the opposite of an unsupported assertion.

candidate_dispositions.reason: The claim asserts a single dominant pattern across all cited excerpts, which is unsupported. The excerpts represent distinct debates on Brexit, legislative provisions, and parliamentary procedure, demonstrating a fragmented policy landscape. There is no evidence of a single, overarching pattern across these diverse contexts. The evidence highlights the specific contexts and agendas
